**Newsletter: Repair Café Accepts Bicycle Wheels on June 3**

**Subject:** Repair Café Launches New Service: Accepting Bicycle Wheels on June 3

**Preheader:** Interested in repairing your bicycle wheels? Join us at the Repair Café on June 3!

**Body:**

Dear community,

We're excited to announce a new service at our Repair Café! Starting from June 3, we will accept bicycle wheels for repair. This initiative aims to make our services more inclusive and accessible for all cyclists.

**How it works:**

- Book a slot in advance: Visit our website or our social media pages to book your slot.
- Bring your bicycle wheels to the Repair Café: We will accept bicycle wheels from June 3 onwards.
- Our skilled mechanics will repair your wheels, ensuring they are in top condition.

**Join us on June 3:**

- Location: [Insert Location]
- Time: [Insert Time]
- Book your slot here: [Insert Book Slot Link]

**What's next?**

This new service is just the beginning of our commitment to inclusivity. Stay tuned for more updates and opportunities to support our community.

Join us on June 3 and make your bicycle wheels shine again!

**Stay connected:**
